description: Gets travel-insurance quotes from HelloSafe for a trip: priced offers from HelloSafe partners, shown in a comparison widget. Required: countryResidence, arrivalCountries (not for an annual multi-trip cover, which is worldwide), traveller ages, the trip length as endDate or durationDays (not for an annual or expat cover, which runs a year), and stateResidence for a US resident. Every other field has a default. The trip length is not defaulted: a wrong length gives a wrong price. HelloSafe is a licensed insurance broker, paid a commission by the insurers whose policies it distributes.

cancelForAnyReason.description: Cancel For Any Reason option, like trip cancellation: an add-on bought with the policy (extra cost, a purchase window counted from the first trip payment, usually 75 % of prepaid costs refunded). Sold to US residents only, on a forTourism, cruise or cancellation trip; true keeps the offers that sell it. Defaults to false.

cardId.description: HelloSafe card ID returned by check_card_coverage, for a user who holds a credit card with travel cover: offers are then re-ranked by how well they fill that card's coverage gaps, and each offer lists what it adds over the card (complementsCard).

displayCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code of a display currency other than the trip-cost currency. Without it, amounts are shown in the trip-cost currency.

locale.description: Language the user is writing in, as a BCP 47 tag or 2-letter code (e.g. "fr", "pt-BR"): the widget and all offer texts are localized with it, so when it is set the quote follows the user's language even if it differs from the app UI. When it is absent, the host UI locale is used if the host provides one (not every host does), then English; the quote never depends on a host locale being present.

requiredCoverages.description: Optional filter on policy features, the guarantee filters of the HelloSafe comparison site: only the offers whose contract includes every listed cover are returned, that cover listed first. maternityCover = covers pregnancy; preExistingConditionsCover = covers pre-existing medical conditions; personalLiability; baggage; travelDelay; directHospitalBilling = the insurer pays the hospital directly; disability; searchAndRescue; earlyReturn; tripInterruption; electronics = electronic devices; cashAdvance; expatMaternity, expatDental, expatOptical (expatriates). Each trip purpose has its own filters, as on the site; a cover that is not one of them is ignored and reported. Used when the user asks for a policy that includes this cover; it changes neither prices nor eligibility, and health-related covers are not stored.

subscriptionId.description: Existing subscription ID to update instead of creating a new one.

arrivalCountries.description: Destination countries as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, as an array (["TH","VN"]) or a comma-separated string. "WW" = the whole world (forTourism, cruise, digitalNomad); "SCH" = the whole Schengen area (schengenArea). Required, except for intent "annual": a yearly multi-trip cover is worldwide and uses no destination.

countryResidence.description: User's country of residence as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. "FR"). It decides which insurers can cover the traveller; it cannot be deduced from the destination or the conversation language.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for tripPrice. Defaults to the currency of countryResidence.

durationDays.description: Trip length in whole days; the server computes endDate = startDate + durationDays. One of durationDays or endDate gives the trip length (not for an annual or expat cover). It is not defaulted: a wrong length gives a wrong price.

endDate.description: Trip end date (YYYY-MM-DD). The quote needs the trip length: endDate or durationDays (not for an annual or expat cover, which runs a year). It comes from the dates or duration given and is not defaulted, because a wrong length gives a wrong price.

intent.description: Trip purpose. Leisure, holidays, sightseeing, a business trip, a visit back home or a rental stay → "forTourism"; study abroad, Erasmus, internship → "studyInternship"; working-holiday visa (PVT) → "whv"; yearly multi-trip cover → "annual"; long-term relocation → "expat"; cancellation-only (no medical) → "cancellation"; ski / trek / mountaineering → "forTourism" with the extreme sports option; cruise → "cruise"; remote-work nomading → "digitalNomad"; group of 10+ travellers → "groupTravel"; Schengen visa application → "schengenArea"; humanitarian mission or volunteering → "humanitarian"; au pair placement → "auPair". The purpose decides which policies are offered: a wrong one gives offers built for another trip. Defaults to "forTourism". "annual" and "expat" set isAnnual=true.

isAnnual.description: Annual / multi-trip cover. Defaults to false (auto-true for intent="annual" or "expat").

shouldCoverCancellation.description: Include trip cancellation coverage. Defaults to false.

shouldCoverExtremeSports.description: Extreme sports option (mountaineering, off-piste skiing, diving, paragliding, climbing), added to the policy at extra cost like trip cancellation. Defaults to false; only relevant when the trip includes such activities.

startDate.description: Trip start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to tomorrow when omitted.

stateResidence.description: State of residence as its USPS 2-letter code (e.g. "CA", "TX"). Required for a US resident: US travel insurance is regulated state by state, and no quote is computed without it. Ignored for every other country. The US territories are countries here, not states (a Puerto Rico resident is countryResidence "PR", never "US" + "PR").

studiesAmount.description: Tuition fees to cover, in tripInfo.currency. Required when studiesInterruption=true.

studiesInterruption.description: Cover interrupted studies (intent="studyInternship" only). Defaults to false. Requires studiesAmount when true.

travellers.description: All travellers covered by the policy, including children. Example: a couple aged 35 with a 5-year-old → [{age:35},{age:35},{age:5}].

tripBoughtDate.description: Date the trip was booked (YYYY-MM-DD). Required when shouldCoverCancellation=true (most insurers require booking within ~30 days).

tripPrice.description: TOTAL trip cost for ALL travellers (not per traveller). Only used by cancellation coverage.

name: get_quote

_assistantGuidance.description: Context of the result: what the widget already shows, how offers were ranked, and a summary of the recommended offer.

context.description: Facts about what the widget shows and how the offers were ranked.

coverages.description: Coverage label → covered amount for the recommended offer.

optionsNotTaken.description: Options available on the recommended offer that this quote does NOT include (not covered unless the user adds them).

recommendedOffer.description: Compact summary of the offer HelloSafe recommends for this trip.

cardContext.description: Present only when the quote was computed against a card (cardId argument): the card and its gaps.

gaps.description: The card coverage gaps that drove the offer ranking.

displayOffers.description: Priced offers sorted by price, with the recommended offer (isBestScore=true) promoted first.

complementsCard.description: Only when the quote carries a cardId: labels of the card's coverage gaps this offer fills — what it adds over the user's card.

faq.description: Frequently asked questions about this offer.

featureDetails.description: Second line of a feature row, part of that guarantee: on cancelTrip, the covered cancellation reasons (e.g. "Any justified reason"). They share the verdict of cancelTrip — never a cover of their own.

features.description: Coverage feature slug → formatted covered amount, already filtered for the trip purpose and converted to the display currency. Slugs listed in optionalFeatures are NOT covered: they are options the traveller has not added (value "Optional"). When cancellation is an option, its covered reasons are in featureDetails.cancelTrip, part of that guarantee and never covered on their own; on a cancellation-only trip they are their own cancellationReasons entry.

insurerLogoUrl.description: Absolute URL of the insurer logo.

isBestScore.description: True for the single offer HelloSafe recommends for this trip (shown first).

isStartingPrice.description: True when the price is a "from" price.

name.description: Commercial name of the offer / formula.

notIncludedFeatures.description: Feature slugs of `features` that this offer does NOT cover (value "Not included"), listed last like the results page's "Not covered" section.

optionalFeatures.description: Feature slugs of `features` that are options NOT taken on this quote (trip cancellation, studies interruption, extreme sports): available on the offer, not covered.

priceFullText.description: Total price for the whole trip and all travellers, formatted in the display currency (e.g. "34,20 €").

priceParts.description: Price split into rendering parts (used by the widget).

profileGuarantees.description: What the contract of each offer states on four guarantees, for every offer that documents them (contract facts, the same for every buyer): pregnancyCover (value = last covered week of pregnancy, e.g. "35 wks"), preExistingConditions (illnesses known before departure), seniorConditions (value = maximum age covered, in years), cancelAnyReason (Cancel For Any Reason, US residents only: value = share of prepaid non-refundable costs refunded; always an add-on bought with the policy at extra cost, not in priceFullText). covered=false means the offer does not cover it. description is HelloSafe's summary of the contract for this trip purpose; exclusions is given for the covers asked with requiredCoverages or cancelForAnyReason.

subscribeUrl.description: HelloSafe comparator URL for this quote, where the user compares and buys. The widget shows it as a button on each offer.

suffix.description: Price period suffix key: "perMonth", "perYear", "perDay" or empty.

takenOptions.description: Feature slugs of the options the traveller added on this quote (trip cancellation, extreme sports, studies interruption): covered, and part of their quote.

topBanner.description: Short marketing highlight for this offer, if any.

error.description: Human-readable reason when the quote could not be generated. Absent on success.

subscribeUrl.description: HelloSafe comparator URL for this quote, where the user compares and buys. The widget shows it as a button on each offer.

subscriptionId.description: Quote session ID; sent back as `subscriptionId`, it updates this quote instead of creating a new one.

translations.description: Localized UI strings consumed by the widget — not meant for the assistant.

tripInfo.description: Normalized trip parameters the quote was computed with.

arrivalCountriesNames.description: Destination country names in the response locale.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency the amounts are shown in.

tripPrice.description: Trip cost per traveller; -1 when not provided.

title: Get travel insurance quotes
